official_entity: Foundation (zaklada) - Zakon o zakladama i fondacijama, court registry (sudski registar)
key_check: Foreign founder allowed, no residency rule; deed of establishment must be notarized (via local notary/POA) then court-registered.
Must be based in England/Wales (local postal address + governing document); no trustee-residency rule.

official_entity: Association (ichud) - Associations Law 5750-1990, Registrar of Associations
key_check: Requires 7 members and a registered Israeli office (lease >=1 yr); remote-only founders must secure a local address.

official_entity: Foundation - Seychelles Foundation Law, FSA/SBORA registry
key_check: No local presence required; foreign founder may be a councillor; FSA registration fee ~US$200 plus ~US$200 annual.

official_entity: NGO Secretariat (Ministry of Foreign Affairs) NGO registration
key_check: All international NGOs must register with the NGO Secretariat; MFA approval and a local address/agent required.
